news.headline: NWS Melbourne Mon Nov 23, 2:25 AM: River Flood Warnings remain in effect for the St. Johns River at Cocoa, Geneva, Astor, DeLand and Sanford — all five points are in Major Flood Stage or forecast to reach it in coming days, with prolonged flooding expected and additional rises possible from mid-week rain; Melbourne is cloudy Mon at midday at 67°F, high 70°F, rain chance 1% at noon

$150 million construction permit issued for 42-story 1775 Biscayne in Miami — Florida YIMBY reports Nov 23 the permit for the mixed-use tower under construction at 1775 Biscayne Boulevard in Miami's Arts & Entertainment District

Rockledge Villas, a 93-unit community in Rockledge, sold for $11 million — Marcus & Millichap arranged the sale of the 87,629-square-foot property at 1525 S. Fiske Blvd., with eight two-story buildings on a 6-acre lot

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper roars back Mon Nov 23 after entering a bear market Fri — Comex copper for December delivery jumped as much as 5.5% to $5.787 a pound in early New York trade, trading at $5.762 ($12,703 a tonne), after settling Fri at $5.485, down 9.9% on the week and 20.4% below the Sep 9 record settlement of $6.889; the rebound followed Nvidia reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO

Midterm results could accelerate state push for A3 refrigerants — ACHR News: ACCA, PHCC and HARDI warn differing state rules could push ultra-low-GWP A3 refrigerants such as R-290 (propane) before contractors have adjusted to the A2L transition, and urge contractors to monitor state legislation and comment early on proposed refrigerant and code changes

Stocks rebound sharply Mon Nov 23 as Nvidia reinstates CEO Huang — Barchart: S&P 500 up 5.15%, Dow up 3.05% and Nasdaq 100 up 7.34% in Monday trade, more than recovering Fri's plunges of 3.70% in the S&P 500 and 5.76% in the Nasdaq 100; Nvidia soared more than 30% and the iShares Semiconductor ETF rose more than 13%

Mortgage rates hold Mon Nov 23 — Freddie Mac's 30-year fixed average remains 7.28% as of Thu's survey; futures still price a high chance of a 25-basis-point Fed hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting, Treasury Secretary Bessent warned Sun the Fed may make a policy mistake if it over-tightens, and October PCE inflation and the Q3 GDP second estimate are due Wed

NBA Sun Nov 22 — Miami Heat beat the Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 at Kaseya Center, Bam Adebayo posting a triple-double with 24 points, 15 rebounds and 12 assists for Miami's seventh straight win; Orlando Magic lost at the Washington Wizards 116-96, Kyshawn George scoring 24 for Washington and Tristan da Silva leading Orlando with 18 off the bench

NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all three Florida teams lost: Detroit Lions beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21, Buffalo Bills beat the Miami Dolphins 26-9, and New York Giants upset the Jacksonville Jaguars 23-18; next up Sun Nov 29, Jaguars host the Titans and Dolphins host the Jets
